expectations.text: Loads the Timer A latch at $DC04/$DC05
expectations.evidence: lda #$25 / sta $dc04 (LO), lda #$40 / sta $dc05 (HI) loads 16421=$4025 into latch

expectations.text: Enables the Timer A interrupt in the ICR $DC0D (with bit 7 set to mark 'set', bit 0 for timer A)
expectations.evidence: lda #$81 (%10000001 bit7=set, bit0=Timer A); sta $dc0d enables Timer A IRQ

expectations.text: Starts the timer via control register A $DC0E (with continuous reload)
expectations.evidence: writes $dc0e with ora #%00010001 (bit4 force-load, bit0 start); continuous mode bit3=0 auto-reloads

expectations.text: Acknowledges/handles by reading $DC0D in the IRQ handler
expectations.evidence: irq: lda $dc0d reads ICR to ack/clear Timer A IRQ
